diff --git a/python/archive_path/archive_path.py b/python/archive_path/archive_path.py
index c5363ee..be53379 100644
--- a/python/archive_path/archive_path.py
+++ b/python/archive_path/archive_path.py
@@ -1,2 +1,38 @@
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_DRIVE_LETTER_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z]:")
+
+
 def safe_archive_path(root, member_name):
-    return root / member_name
+    """Return a pathlib.Path for member_name safely contained beneath root.
+
+    Performs purely lexical checks on member_name (a portable archive member
+    name using forward slashes) to reject absolute paths, Windows drive
+    letters, backslash separators, NUL bytes, empty components, and any
+    ".." traversal component.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(member_name, str):
+        raise ValueError(f"member_name must be a string: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if "\0" in member_name:
+        raise ValueError(f"member_name contains NUL byte: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if "\\" in member_name:
+        raise ValueError(f"member_name contains backslash separator: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if member_name.startswith("/"):
+        raise ValueError(f"member_name is an absolute path: {member_name!r}")
+
+    components = member_name.split("/")
+
+    if any(_DRIVE_LETTER_RE.match(component) for component in components):
+        raise ValueError(f"member_name contains a drive letter: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if any(component == "" for component in components):
+        raise ValueError(f"member_name has empty path components: {member_name!r}")
+
+    if any(component == ".." for component in components):
+        raise ValueError(f"member_name contains a '..' component: {member_name!r}")
+
+    return Path(root).joinpath(*components)
